answer: My answer to sybils is Licensed plumber certificate with trade board attestation — a trade-board licence number that checks out live — which makes the delta of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Honest agents barely notice the check, because a trade-board licence number that checks out live is something they already have; the ledge falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the pearl of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
